name: LocationReasoner
description: LocationReasoner is a benchmark designed to evaluate LLMs' reasoning abilities in real-world site selection tasks involving spatial, environmental, and logistic constraints, supported by a sandbox environment and automated verification.
reputation: A newly proposed benchmark for real-world site selection reasoning; promising but not yet broadly adopted as a standard evaluation.
notes: Focuses on real-world complex reasoning for site selection; includes sandbox tools and scalable queries; highlights LLM limitations in holistic reasoning.
